```plato
    // True when the reading's own trustworthiness reaches the threshold.
    // Distinct from the value's uncertainty: a high-quality reading of a
    // noisy quantity is still uncertain.
    IsTrusted(self: Measurement<$T>, threshold: Probability): Boolean
        => self.Quality.Value >= threshold.Value;
```
